injuries.name: Carson Schwesinger
injuries.note: Schwesinger sustained a Grade 1 right ankle sprain during the Browns' 17-12 loss to the Jets on Sunday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Quinshon Judkins
injuries.note: Judkins was wearing a walking boot on his right foot after Sunday's 17-12 loss at the Jets, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

injuries.name: KC Concepcion
injuries.note: Concepcion has entered the NFL's concussion protocol, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reported Sunday.

injuries.name: Raheim Sanders
injuries.note: Sanders (hip) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.

injuries.name: Tytus Howard
injuries.note: Howard (knee) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.

injuries.name: Taylen Green
injuries.note: Green (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jets, though he will serve as the Browns' emergency quarterback.

injuries.name: Kalia Davis
injuries.note: Davis (quadriceps) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.

injuries.name: Dillon Gabriel
injuries.note: Gabriel (back) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Kenyon Sadiq
injuries.note: Sadiq won't return to Sunday's game versus the Browns due to a concussion.

injuries.name: Joseph Ossai
injuries.note: Ossai (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Browns, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

injuries.name: Braiden McGregor
injuries.note: McGregor (pectoral) was placed on the Jets' injured reserve list Wednesday, Eric Allen of the team's official site reports.
